title: Recall Double Angle Formulas
text: Recall the double angle formulas for cosine and sine: cos(2theta) $$=$$ $$2cos^2\left(\theta\right)$$ - $$1$$ or $$1$$ - $$2sin^2\left(\theta\right)$$ or $$cos^2\left(\theta\right)$$ - $$sin^2\left(\theta\right)$$ and sin(2theta) $$=$$ 2sin(theta)cos(theta). Also recall tan(theta) $$=$$ $$\fracsin^c\left(\theta\right)os\left(\theta\right)}$$.
